name: Topographic illumination and shadowing
purpose: Compare the production terrain-horizon and Earth-eclipse service with independent D02 polar visibility/PSR evidence and published temporal sampling.
configuration: Explicit srcMoon/examples/lola_surface.in M2 receipt; eight MPI ranks; no inferred constants.
inputs: required authoritative package metadata and processed products
independent_reference: Roadmap-defined analytical invariant and/or independently processed authoritative evidence; never frozen production output as physical truth.
units: SI in model artifacts; native archive units retained with explicit conversions
frame_time_convention: MOON_ME_DE421 body-fixed geometry, LSO particle state, SPICE TDB internally, archive UTC where supplied
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Random seed and MPI/OpenMP layout recorded; stochastic criteria use declared confidence intervals.
procedure: Verify I13 and data readiness, launch the normal linked application, retain all artifacts, then apply this ID's frozen roadmap criterion.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly the I15 criteria in srcMoon/development_and_validation.md; thresholds are not relaxed after execution.
expected_pass_result: The declared linked M2 capability is evaluated and every frozen criterion is met.
data_hashes: Recorded in run_manifest.json after package hash verification.
status_semantics: PASS means the full linked criterion ran and passed; FAIL means it ran and missed the criterion; ERROR is infrastructure/parser/corruption; SKIPPED means a prerequisite, capability, configuration, or authoritative input is unavailable.
